title: Subprocessors List
shortSummary: Lists third-party infrastructure and payment providers utilized by Histeria (e.g. Razorpay).

sections.heading: 1. Active Subprocessors & Third-Party Services
paragraphs: The following third-party service providers process data on behalf of Histeria to deliver infrastructure, payment, and authentication capabilities:

subprocessors.name: Razorpay Software Private Limited
subprocessors.purpose: Payment processing, subscription billing, and invoice checkout

subprocessors.name: Google LLC (Google Identity Services)
subprocessors.purpose: Single sign-on authentication and OAuth credential verification
